unverified: A Port Royal night-use ordinance was reported in the press. The ordinance text naming streets was not found, so roads follow 56-2-90 and the map keeps the daylight flag.

enforcement.note: Posted signs do not lift a ban. A designated street list that is not digitized stays red for plain golf carts.

cart_only_bans.label: S.C. Code 56-2-90: golf carts are not allowed on a primary highway. Ribaut Road (US 21) is a primary road.
